column1: # Address Library IDs for the old-gen build (Fallout 4 1.10.163, F4SE 0.6.23).
# CommonLibF4 targets next-gen and uses IDs above 2,000,000 for code that moved in next-gen; the
# 1.10.163 Address Library does not have them. scripts/oldgen.py writes RE/IDs.h and
# RE/IDs_VTABLE.h with these replaced, and fails the old-gen build if the DLL uses an
# unlisted one. All other IDs the plugin uses (e.g. the Pip-Boy vtables) already are old-gen IDs.
# Evidence: alandtse = RelocationID(old-gen, next-gen) in github.com/alandtse/CommonLibF4;
# f4se = same symbol at both offsets in F4SE 0.6.23 and 0.7.9 sources; code = the two
# Fallout4.exe functions match; xref = old-gen global read by the matching instruction of
# paired functions; rtti = found through the type's RTTI vtable.
